claim: Anthony Fauci the NIAID director is a democrat.

sub_claims.question: Is Anthony Fauci the director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) as of 2020?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Anthony Fauci has been the director of NIAID since 1984 and held the position in 2020.

evidence.statement: Anthony Fauci was appointed Director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) in 1984 and has continuously served in that position.

sub_claims.question: Is Anthony Fauci affiliated with the Democratic Party?
sub_claims.answer: No, Anthony Fauci is generally considered non-partisan and has not publicly declared allegiance to the Democratic Party, often avoiding political affiliations in his role.

evidence.statement: In public statements and interviews during his career, including during the COVID-19 pandemic, Anthony Fauci has consistently identified as a scientist and public health official who is not affiliated with any political party.
